name: The Lifted Veil
description: A single lifted ivory fold within a fine lapis arch.
material: The arch is deep lapis with one pale-gold inset line. The single diagonal sweeping veil and its fine inner fold are warm carved ivory with 2 long delicate incisions. Geometry remains spare and asymmetric.

name: The Lancet
description: A pointed portal, rendered in ivory and midnight blue.
material: The gently pointed outer portal is matte warm ivory with a fine champagne-gold inner seam. The two slender inner fold contours are smoky lapis with silver-blue vein highlights. Very quiet exact tip and fine taper.

name: The Quiet Opening
description: An asymmetric opening in pale gold and carved ivory.
material: The outer opening and its rising left side are smooth antique ivory, its single inner flowing return lapis blue edged with hairline pale gold. Keep the off-centre shape and natural calligraphic turn. Two materials meet at precise clean joins.

name: Silk A
description: The Arcana initial shaped as a softly folded ivory ribbon.
material: The letter A's two tapered uprights are warm ivory, and its soft suspended crossbar is fine lapis blue edged with champagne-gold. Convey a single long delicate silk crease in each broad ivory surface. Precise terminal points, exquisite curved gold seam along the crossbar.

name: Enfolded
description: An open Olivia oval made from two sculptural folds.
material: The outer open oval is satin warm ivory, softly folded with one very fine incision; the inner returning veil is deep blue lapis with a pale-gold edge. Preserve the slender ends and the open counter. Pure shape without added elements.

name: The Joined Initials
description: The OA monogram as an inlaid lapis-and-ivory signature.
material: The O is warm carved ivory with a very fine pale-gold inset along its inner edge, the A is deep lapis edged in softly brushed pale gold. The overlapped letters are precisely inlaid, one coherent object, no tangled or melted junctions. Keep exact letterform outlines.
